sentences.text: HON'BLE
MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY

ORAL ORDER 1. Accused in Crime No.238/2024 registered Bagalagunte Police Station, Bengaluru City, for the offences punishable under Sections 506, 376 and 420 of IPC, is before this Court under Section 439 of Cr.P.C.
2.
Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

3. FIR in Crime No.238/2024 was registered by Bagalagunte Police Station, Bengaluru City, against the petitioner herein for the aforesaid offences on the basis of the first information dated 15.06.2024 received from victim girl aged about 24 years.
During the course of investigation, petitioner was arrested on 18.06.2024 and remanded to judicial custody.
Bail application filed by the petitioner before the jurisdictional Sessions Court in Crl.Misc.No.5981/2024 was rejected on 11.07.2024.
Therefore, he is before this Court.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the material on record would go to show that petitioner and the victim girl were in love.

After their relationship got strained, the victim girl has made false allegations against the petitioner and NC: 2024:KHC:37608 the present criminal case is registered only as a counter to the complaint submitted by the father of the petitioner.
He submits that petitioner has no criminal antecedents and is in custody from 18.06.2024.
Accordingly, he prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.

6. A perusal of the typed first information dated 15.06.2024 submitted by the victim girl aged about 24 years would go to show that she got acquainted with the petitioner in the year 2018 and subsequently they started to love each other.

The allegation in the first information is that from the year 2018 onwards till the year 2024, petitioner had taken the victim girl to various places and on the promise of marrying her, he had sexual intercourse with her.
It is also alleged that he had captured some photographs of the victim girl and was threatening her that he would be circulating the said photographs.

The material on record would go to show that prior to the victim girl Akshay Kumar B H vs State By Bagalagunte Police Station on 12 September, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/69104425/
2 submitting the first information dated 15.06.2024, father of the petitioner herein had approached the Station House Officer of Belluru Police Station, Mandya District and submitted his first information based on which NCR case NC: 2024:KHC:37608 was registered and in the said case,
the victim girl had given her statement before the police on 29.05.2024.

sentences.text: The allegations now found in the first information are not made in her statement that was made before the police on 29.05.2024.
Be that as it may, petitioner, who has no criminal antecedents is in custody from 18.06.2024.
Major portion of the investigation in the case is completed.
Considering the aforesaid aspects of the matter, I am of the opinion that his prayer for grant of regular bail requires to be answered affirmatively.
Accordingly, the following order:-
7. The petition is allowed.
